t_start.data_reference: paci2013computational; same timing as the Paci stim_mode (i_stim_Start = 0 s)

t_end.data_reference: paci2013computational; same timing as the Paci stim_mode (i_stim_End = 800 s)

period.data_reference: paci2013computational; 1 s pacing period (60/i_stim_frequency with i_stim_frequency = 60)

i_amplitude.data_reference: paci2013computational; i_stim_Amplitude = 5.5e-10 A = 0.55 nA (hiPSC-CM scale; adult myocyte models typically need larger currents)
